status: Exploration palette; existing core colors retained, derived colors proposed

combinations.name: Blue + lime
combinations.instruction: Blue is dominant, lime is the bright organic accent, forest adds depth.

combinations.name: Forest + ice
combinations.instruction: Deep forest atmosphere with luminous ice-blue light.

combinations.name: Pale daylight
combinations.instruction: High-key pale daylight, gentle washed blue and pistachio; airy, not grey.

combinations.name: Electric blue
combinations.instruction: Vivid blue light with substantial dark blue depth, small white highlights.

combinations.name: Lime forward
combinations.instruction: Fresh lime and green dominate; warm chalk is the quiet space.

combinations.name: Chalk + forest
combinations.instruction: Restrained chalk and forest contrast, sage midtones; no bright blue.

combinations.name: Blue hour
combinations.instruction: Moody blue hour, quiet reflective light, cinematic but not futuristic.

combinations.name: Washed color
combinations.instruction: Soft faded pigments, palest blue and lime haze, fine analog grain.

combinations.name: Reference tonality
combinations.instruction: No numeric palette. Derive color balance and emotional temperature from the supplied reference, interpreting it freely instead of copying the composition.

combinations.name: Open exploration
combinations.instruction: No imposed palette. Explore a natural or artistic color relationship suggested by this medium and light. This is an intentional open-color control within the study; maintain the quiet composition and tactile atmosphere.
